steps.text: Click Form on the Model rail, then Start from: Cylinder.
Symmetry: Circular, 4 copies. One lobe edited is four lobes edited.
Click a middle-ring point, Shift+click the two above and below it. Drag the red X arrow out 10 mm.
The column between two lobes: drag X in 6 mm, then Y in 6 mm. Finger valleys, all four at once.
Left-drag down on empty space to look from above. Click the top face, drag Z down 8 mm: a lower crown.
Left-drag up to orbit underneath. Click the bottom face, then Crease: the base comes out flat.
Display: Smooth. Name it and Finish: Form writes an exact solid into the design tree.
Standard modeling: sketch a 4 mm circle on XY, extrude it 10 mm down, joined to the knob.
Hole: 3 mm, 12 deep, in the shaft end.
Fillet 1.5 mm on the base rim: a standard fillet on an edge Form made.
Orbit back over the top, Display Mode: Zebra. The stripes run on smoothly across every face.
